newsitem.title: LATVIA: VEREINSBANK, NORDBANKEN SIGN COOPERATION DEAL.
newsitem.headline: VEREINSBANK, NORDBANKEN SIGN COOPERATION DEAL.

text.p: The new Latvian branch of Germany's Vereinsbank said on Monday that it has signed a cooperation agreement with Swedish Nordbanken to service Swedish companies operating in Latvia.
"The two banks will be providing trade-related services to the more than 125 Swedish companies active in Latvia," Vereinsbank Riga president Dietrich Schutte told a news conference.
"We will also be referring business to each other, for example if there are Latvian companies wanting to open business in Sweden, we will be there," he added.
He noted Nordbanken was one of the four largest Swedish banks.
The Riga Vereinsbank branch is part of the German bank's Vereins und Westbank subsidiary.
It began operating on Monday and is the second Western bank to enter Latvia after Societe Generale .
